source_clauses.verbatim: Design a foot pedal for a workbench.
Pressing it should send a signal to the machine.
when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own every time.
It should not move if something brushes against it sideways.

requirements.statement_verbatim: Pressing it should send a signal to the machine.
requirements.observable_verbatim: sends a signal to the machine when pressed

requirements.statement_verbatim: when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own every time.
requirements.observable_verbatim: returns to its resting position on its own when foot is removed

requirements.statement_verbatim: It should not move if something brushes against it sideways.
requirements.observable_verbatim: does not move when brushed sideways

scenarios.name: foot pedal operation
scenarios.system_boundary: inside: the foot pedal and its internal components; outside: the user's foot, the machine, and the workbench surface the pedal rests on.

scenarios.name: foot pedal service
scenarios.system_boundary: inside: the foot pedal and its internal components; outside: the user's hand or tool, the workbench surface, and any support structure.

actors.name: user
must_reach: the foot pedal for maintenance or adjustment

freedoms.decision: Mechanism for sending the signal to the machine
freedoms.why_free: The request says a signal must be sent, but does not specify how (electrical, mechanical, wireless, etc.).

freedoms.decision: Mechanism for returning to resting position
freedoms.why_free: The request says it must return on its own every time, but does not specify the mechanism (spring, gravity, etc.).
The request says it should not move sideways, but does not specify how (guides, friction, etc.).
The request does not specify size, shape, or materials.

ambiguities.statement: It is not clear whether the pedal must remain fixed in position when brushed sideways or whether it may move slightly as long as it does not send a signal.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: clarification with user or from test criteria

ambiguities.statement: It is not clear what 'resting position' means exactly - whether it is the initial at-rest position and how precise the return must be.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: clarification with user or from engineering standards

assumptions.statement: The pedal operates in a workbench environment and is not exposed to harsh conditions.
assumptions.why: The request is for a workbench foot pedal.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: A statement that the pedal must operate in harsh conditions.

assumptions.statement: The user's foot presses downward on the pedal.
assumptions.why: Typical foot pedal operation; not explicitly stated but implied.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: A statement that the pedal is pressed in a different direction.
